episodes.title: Dünya Sancısı
episodes.summary: Şahsu confronts her grandfather, urging him to own up to the past. Maran, who is skeptical about the prophecy, meets Şahsu as the first omen occurs.

episodes.title: Yağmurun Söyledikleri
episodes.summary: The Mar people see the Anavarza disaster as a sign of more trouble to come. Şahsu worries that someone is following her. Maran and Şahsu get closer.

episodes.title: Kararsız Denge
episodes.summary: After an eerie encounter at the school, Şahsu is made to believe she was hallucinating. At home, she starts to see her grandfather in a new light.

episodes.title: İnanmanın Dayanılmaz Hafifliği
episodes.summary: Şahsu feels at home for the first time ever. Maran saves her from a dangerous situation, but she realizes he's not telling her the entire truth.

episodes.title: Gelecek Değişir
episodes.summary: Maran takes a distressed Şahsu to a private place, where they have a heart-to-heart, but he notices they're being watched.

episodes.title: Hayat Gürültüsü
episodes.summary: Under Arun's influence, Cihan becomes a threat to Şahsu. Maran undergoes an excruciating phase. A night drive takes a sinister turn.

episodes.title: Aşkın Tekerrürü
episodes.summary: As his state of mind becomes worrisome, Davut has an honest chat with Şahsu. With tensions rising among the Mar people, Ural comes up with an idea.

episodes.title: İçimdeki Yılan
episodes.summary: Şahsu chooses to trust Maran and surrenders to love. As the last omen occurs, Maran is forced to show his true self. And for Şahsu, there's no turning back.

episodes.title: İçimizde Uyuyanlar
episodes.summary: A vengeful Lilith emerges from captivity. Şahsu begins to experience frightening changes. A sudden tragedy forces Maran to return to his roots.

episodes.title: Festina Lente
episodes.summary: Şahsu faces her first trial. Lilith makes it her mission to understand the rhythms of human life. Mayhem breaks out in the Mar neighborhood.

episodes.title: Sevmek Öldürmez
episodes.summary: Love and loss collide as Şahsu takes on her second trial. Lilith manipulates someone dear to Maran, leading to a heartbreaking confrontation.

episodes.title: Aşka ve Ölüme Dair
episodes.summary: After a devastating attack, Maran steps up to defend his community. An unexpected ally emerges, but is it enough to stop Lilith?

episodes.title: Hüküm Vakti
episodes.summary: Şahsu's final trial tests her limits and reveals a secret that leads her to a moment of profound transformation.

episodes.title: Döngü
episodes.summary: Shahmaran plots to vanquish Lilith once and for all. A surprising turn of events sets the stage for a new beginning for Şahsu and Maran.
